# WT99P4C5-S1 BSP provenance

This component was imported from `wireless-tag-com/WT99P4C5-S1` commit
`cfedb303b3c21a5e4d15ab28d320aec9f0f5b707`.

Project-local changes:

- pin the EK79007 and GT911 component versions used for initial bring-up;
- compile out ES8311/I2S support because audio runs on an external processor;
- identify the board as WT99P4C5-S1 instead of the copied Function EV Board name.
